changelog:
• Fixed series streaming — episodes were playing short app update video instead of actual content.
• Added CloudFront policy parsing — extracts real DASH manifest URLs from signCookie when direct URL contains bad hash.
• Expanded bad hash filtering — now filters 3 known bad hashes and notice/deprecation URLs.
• Fixed bad hash check logic — now only checks the final URL being used, not both direct and DASH URLs.
• Improved API endpoint compatibility — removed host parameter from play-info queries to match working implementations.
